name: Naruto: Semejnyj Otdyh
source: Naruto is the strongest and most recognizable ninja in the world. He is the head of the land of fire - the Hokage. There are lots of cases at the Hokage post, and he does not have time to pay attention to his family. To fix this, Naruto took a week off. But there was an unpredictable problem. Choose how he will spend this family vacation.
